title: Quiz: Version Control Basics
description: Check your understanding of Version Control Basics.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in PHP?
questions.explanation: In PHP, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What is a commit?
options: A saved snapshot of your code at a point in time
questions.correctAnswer: A saved snapshot of your code at a point in time
questions.explanation: Commits let you revisit or revert any past state.

questions.question: True or False: You should commit code only when the whole project is finished.
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: git ___ -m "message"   // save a snapshot
questions.explanation: commit records your staged changes permanently.

questions.question: In PHP, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
